# Collision: imported method T.As must not reuse clean func As fact.
# Producer: clean func As (pure read) + mutating method T.As (t.S[0]=1).
# Consumer const-receiver caller must REJECT with const_view_mutation;
# clean func path runs native. Pre-fix: mutating build wrongly succeeds (RED).

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd cleancons
logos build -o $WORK/bin/cleancons$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/bin/cleancons$GOEXE
stdout '^clean-ok$'
cd ..

cd mutcons
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
cd ..

-- lib/go.mod --
module example.com/collib

go 1.27

-- lib/c/c.lgo --
package c

func As(s []int) int {
	return s[0]
}

type T struct {
	S []int
}

func (t T) As() int {
	t.S[0] = 1
	return t.S[0]
}

-- cleancons/go.mod --
module example.com/cleancons

go 1.27

require example.com/collib v0.0.0

replace example.com/collib => ../lib

-- cleancons/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/collib/c"
)

func Wrap(s []int) int {
	return c.As(s)
}

func main() {
	if Wrap([]int{7}) != 7 {
		panic("bad")
	}
	fmt.Println("clean-ok")
}

-- mutcons/go.mod --
module example.com/mutcons

go 1.27

require example.com/collib v0.0.0

replace example.com/collib => ../lib

-- mutcons/mut.lgo --
package mutcons

import "example.com/collib/c"

func Attack(t const c.T) int {
	return t.As()
}
